p: layest waste: Meaning, the enemies of the Church, as were the Chaldeans and Assyrians, but chiefly of Sennacherib, but not only.
cease to lay waste: When your appointed time will come that God will take away your power: and that which you have wrongfully gained, will be given to others, as in Am 5:11.
they shall deal treacherously with thee: The Chaldeans will do the same to the Assyrians, as the Assyrians did to Israel, and the Medes and Persians will do the same to the Chaldeans.
O LORD: He declares by this what is the chief refuge of the faithful, when troubles come, to pray, and seek help from God.
their arm every morning: Which helped our fathers as soon as they called on you.
people fled: That is, the Assyrians fled before the army of the Chaldeans, or the Chaldeans for fear of the Medes and Persians.
lifting up of thyself the nations: When you, O Lord, lifted up your arm to punish your enemies.
caterpiller: You who as caterpillars destroyed with your number the whole world, will have no strength to resist your enemies the Chaldeans: but will be gathered on a heap and destroyed.
he run upon them: Meaning, the Medes and Persians against the Chaldeans.
thy times: That is, in the days of Hezekiah.
their valiant ones shall cry outside: Sent from Sennacherib.
ambassadors of peace shall weep bitterly: Whom they of Jerusalem sent to intreat of peace.
highways lie waste: These are the words of the ambassadors, when they returned from Sennacherib.
Sharon is like a wilderness: Which was a plentiful country, meaning, that Sennacherib would destroy all.
rise: To help and deliver my Church.

Ye shall conceive chaff: This is spoken against the enemies, who thought all was their own, but he shows that their enterprise will be in vain, and that the fire which they had kindled for others would consume them.
far off: His vengeance will be so great that all the world will talk of it.
sinners in Zion are afraid: Which do not believe the words of the prophet, and the assurance of their deliverance.
high: Meaning, that God will be a sure defence to all them that live according to his word.
see the king in his beauty: They will see Hezekiah delivered from his enemies and restored to honour and glory.
land that is very far off: They will be no more shut in as they were by Sennacherib, but go where it pleases them.

shall meditate terror: Before this liberty comes you will think that you are in great danger: for the enemy will so sharply assail you that one will cry "Where is the clerk that writes the names of them who are taxed?" another, "Where is the receiver?" another will cry for him that values the rich houses, but God will deliver you from this fear.
of broad rivers and streams: Let us be content with this small river of Shiloah and not desire the great streams and rivers, by which the enemies may bring in ships and destroy us.
tacklings are loosed: He derides the Assyrians and enemies of the Church, declaring their destruction as they who perish by shipwreck.
prey of a great spoil divided: He comforts the Church, and shows that they will be enriched with all benefits both of body and soul.
